title: Design System: RULLY PANJI M.P. - Civil Works Site

display.purpose: Hero and section headlines, uppercase, Chakra Petch 700.

body.purpose: Prose paragraphs, Indonesian sentence case, capped max 62ch. English is annotation-only.

annotation.purpose: All labels below 0.85rem: ledge names, section tags, stamps, readouts, form labels, buttons, and every English annotation. Share Tech Mono uppercase.

rails.name: ledge-splice
rails.purpose: The hazard-splice rail closing each ledge beam (×5) and the footer rail. The only two placements of hazard stripes in the system.

motion.name: reveal-stagger

motion.purpose: Staggered entry for card grids and module lists.

motion.name: touch-travel

motion.purpose: Hard-state tactile feedback; the only lift mechanism, never a shadow.

narrative.overview: RULLY PANJI M.P. presents the portfolio as a monitored civil construction site. Each section is a structure in progress: a ledge beam carries the section identity, a hazard-splice rail closes the slab, concrete panels hold the plates, and every datum is entered into a ruled register cell. The visitor reads a construction file: a surveyor's ledger, honest sample plates stamped CONTOH, an installed-machinery report, and a work-order form, bilingual because a real field file in Indonesia is written in Bahasa Indonesia and annotated in English by the contractors who read it. Sharp lines, ruled cells, one mechanism (the ledge + register) repeated with discipline, mono annotation, and zero ornamental shadow communicate 'built by hand, standards-first' to both audiences.
keyCharacteristics: The ledge is the section spine: a protruding concrete beam opening every sheet with a solid ref slab, mono section name, and a diagonal hazard-splice rail.
The register is the data atom: dt/dd cells, 1px row rulings, mono bilingual labels left, values right. Repeated across the DOSSIER, HIGHLIGHT GROUP, CONTACT LINES, and module tags.
Concrete panels carry the plates: hero portrait, card art, and modal art all sit on concrete fills behind 2px rulings.
Hazard splices appear exactly twice: the ledge rails and the footer rail. Safety orange stays a signal-only color, never a surface fill.
Copy is bilingual: Bahasa Indonesia is the spoken voice; English is the annotation voice on every structured label (NAMA / NAME, CONTOH / SAMPLE).
Portrait rendered grayscale 4:4.6 inside a ruled plate on a concrete panel with a hazard clip, reading as a survey datum.
All three karya tiles are schematic plates stamped CONTOH / SAMPLE and footnoted as study samples; no fabricated client work.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Safety orange is the only chromatic color. It appears as text only via accent-ink variants clearing 4.5:1 on their surface; the raw accent value is reserved for marks, frames, focus, hover, and hazard-splice stripes.

rules.name: The Ruling Rule
rules.body: Borders are the shadow system. 2px ink rulings define sheets, cards, buttons, spec cells, and ledge beams; 1px line-soft rulings separate rows inside them. No drop shadows, no glows, no inner bevels.

rules.name: The Ledge Rule
rules.body: Every section opens with a ledge beam. It replaces decorative eyebrows; the ledge is the section's filing reference, a structural element, not a label.

rules.name: The Hazard-Splice Limit
rules.body: Diagonal accent stripes appear exactly twice per page: the ledge rails and the footer rail. A third occurrence is a violation.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Chakra Petch speaks prose and headlines; Share Tech Mono annotates every label below 0.85rem and every English annotation. A readout is never set in Chakra Petch.

rules.name: The Bilingual Register Rule
rules.body: Structured copy is written ID + EN together (NAMA / NAME). Prose stays Indonesian; English is the recording voice rendered in mono ink-soft.

rules.name: The Hard-Shape Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 for every surface, button, frame, input, ledge, and panel. The shape lock is absolute: no pills, no rounded corners, no circle avatars.

dos: Do give every section a ledge beam: ref slab + mono name + hazard-splice rail.
Do keep every surface sharp (radius 0) and border-ruled; no shadows except the form-focus stamp.
Do stamp placeholder work CONTOH / SAMPLE and explain it in a footnote; never fake client work.
Do keep the portrait grayscale and framed on concrete like a survey datum.
Do obey the one-accent rule: safety orange only as signal; use accent-ink for text.
Do write structured labels bilingually (NAMA / NAME) and keep prose in Indonesian.
Do limit hazard splices to ledge rails and the footer rail.
Do let mono own every label; let Chakra Petch own prose and headlines.
donts: Don't round corners, add drop shadows, glows, gradients, or backdrop blur.
Don't add eyebrows as decoration; the ledge is the filing reference.
Don't repeat the register three times per sheet; a sheet gets one ledger pattern max.
Don't use em-dashes anywhere in copy; a dash is a form separator or arithmetic line.
Don't animate more than the reveal/pop pair; no marquees, no infinite loops, no parallax.
Don't double prose in English; double only the labels.
Don't let the page flip theme mid-scroll; the toggle applies the whole page once.
